name: Connected agent (A2A)
summary: Caller agent that delegates to a remote agent via RemoteA2A connection.
description: Provisions a Foundry Prompt Agent with a BYOM-routed model, attaches an AgentCard, enables both `a2a` and `responses` protocols on `agent_endpoint`, and calls `/agents/{name}/endpoint/protocols/a2a` directly with `DefaultAzureCredential`. The reply text is generated by the BYOM model, proving the prefix survives the A2A hop.
notes:
Verified end-to-end. Server-side recipe:

1. `PATCH /agents/{name}` to attach the `agent_card`.
2. `PATCH /agents/{name}` to set `agent_endpoint.protocols = ['a2a', 'responses']` — **both** are required; an a2a-only endpoint rejects calls with `EndpointProtocolNotEnabled`.
3. Call A2A JSON-RPC `message/send` + poll `tasks/get`.

Auth: bearer token on scope `https://ai.azure.com/.default` (the `cognitiveservices` scope returns 401 server-side). Neither PATCH is exposed on the SDK yet — the raw REST helper lives in `_shared.attach_agent_card`.

The caller-side flow (a Foundry agent invoking this one as a tool) needs a registered A2A connection with credentials and is tracked separately on the `tool-a2a` card.
